How Welcome to Night Vale (novel) connects

  • Topic: Welcome to Night Vale — The 2015 novel extends Welcome to Night Vale into prose.
  • Location: Night Vale — The novel is still set in the town of Night Vale.

What is Welcome to Night Vale (novel)?

The Welcome to Night Vale novel is the 2015 book in which Fink and Cranor leave Cecil's booth for Jackie Fierro and Diane Crayton, still inside the same desert town.

Key threads lead to Welcome to Night Vale and Night Vale.
